system.description: Whenever the Computers system suffers one or more Breaches, it disrupts those functions temporarily. Until the officer at the internal systems position (or someone in Engineering) performs the Restore Minor Action, the Computers system cannot be used to perform or assist any Tasks; additionally, all other Tasks attempted which are assisted by the ship increase their Complication range by 2, until that Restore Minor Action has been performed, due to disruptions in automation.
